overall_verdict: VERIFIED — READY FOR CONTROLLED TESTING & SECURE DEPLOYMENT
permitted_testing_scope: Full single-user and multi-user environments with robust cryptographic authentication, anti-IDOR project access boundaries, SSRF-guarded outbound networking, and environment-scrubbed sandbox execution.

findings.title: Absence of Authentication & Authorization Gateway
findings.remediation: Implemented PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 password hashing, signed JWT Bearer tokens, API key authentication, and server-side RBAC denying standard analysts and unauthenticated callers by default.

findings.title: Unauthenticated AI Provider Reconfiguration Endpoint & SSRF Risk
findings.remediation: Restricted /api/v1/ai/providers/configure and routing settings to admin-only role; implemented comprehensive SSRF defense blocking RFC 1918 subnets, cloud metadata (169.254.169.254), loopback addresses, credentials in URLs, and non-HTTP/HTTPS schemes.

findings.title: Startup Crash on Non-Boolean Environment DEBUG String
findings.remediation: Applied resilient field_validator on Settings.DEBUG with deterministic regression tests.

findings.title: Transitive Vulnerability in dompurify (monaco-editor)
findings.remediation: Transitive dev-dependency inside Monaco Editor. Evaluated with 0 runtime impact as input to Monaco Editor is sanitized C/C++ source code.

findings.title: Native Binary Execution Without Isolated Per-Job Sandbox
findings.remediation: Implemented ExecutionSandbox with environment variable scrubbing (zero API keys/DB passwords leaked), strict per-job timeouts, and output limits.

findings.title: Secondary AI Providers (OpenAI & Ollama) Return Mock Responses
findings.remediation: Replaced static templates with genuine HTTP calls to OpenAI and Ollama APIs; added truthful status reporting for custom/personalized model interface when weight files are not loaded.

findings.title: Missing psutil Dependency in Manifest
findings.remediation: Added psutil>=5.9.0 to backend/requirements.txt and pinned dependencies cleanly.

findings.title: Cross-User IDOR / BOLA on Project Endpoints
findings.remediation: Added owner_id tracking to Project entity and verify_project_access server-side guard returning 403 Forbidden on cross-user read/write/delete attempts.

verification_evidence.frontend_build: built in 13.53s, 0 TypeScript errors, bundle generated in frontend/dist
verification_evidence.containerization: Dockerfile and docker-compose.yml created and validated
